body:
## Summary
`replication_task.go` validates namespace ID, execution, run ID, 
and event versions — but has a TODO noting that version history 
validation is missing.

## Root Cause
```go
// TODO add validation on version history
if valid := validateUUID(request.GetNamespaceId()); !valid {
    return nil, nil, ErrInvalidNamespaceID
}
```
Version history fields are not validated, potentially allowing 
malformed replication tasks to proceed.

## Impact
- Invalid version histories could cause incorrect state replication
- No validation means errors surface later in processing
- Harder to diagnose root cause of replication failures

## Question for team
What specific version history validations should be added? 
Happy to implement once the expected validations are defined.

## References
- `service/history/ndc/replication_task.go:418`
title: Missing version history validation in ReplicateEventsV2 request  processing
